evals.name: agents-package-inference
evals.description: Minimal prompt with no package hint — tests that the skill correctly infers agents for a status-type component and creates only source-layer files
evals.prompt: Create just the source file for an EvalStatusPill component — no story or docs yet
evals.expected_output:
## Source created: EvalStatusPill

**Package:** agents
**Files:**
- packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.tsx
- packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/index.ts
- packages/agents/src/index.ts (updated)
**ARIA pattern:** role="status" + aria-live="polite"
**MCP states:** idle, running, done, error (or equivalent status values)
**Theming:** existing semantic tokens
assertions: Package correctly inferred as agents (not core)
Source file created at packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.tsx
Barrel created at packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/index.ts re-exporting from './EvalStatusPill'
Source exports EvalStatusPill as named export (not default)
Source exports EvalStatusPillProps interface
Source includes role="status" and aria-live="polite" ARIA attributes
Source uses only Chakra semantic tokens — no hardcoded hex values
Source does not read single-mode colorModes values from @agentic-ds/tokens for styling and does not read color mode — light/dark support comes from semantic tokens
Source does NOT have a default React import
packages/agents/src/index.ts exports EvalStatusPill and EvalStatusPillProps
No story file was created at apps/storybook/src/stories/EvalStatusPill.stories.tsx
No spec doc was created at packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.doc.ts
No test file was created at packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.test.tsx

evals.name: already-exists-guard
evals.description: Source file pre-exists — tests that the skill refuses to overwrite and redirects to /update-component
evals.prompt: Create the source for an EvalStatusPill component in agents
evals.expected_output:
## Already exists: EvalStatusPill

`packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.tsx` already exists.
Use `/update-component EvalStatusPill` to audit and update it instead.
assertions: Skill did not overwrite packages/agents/src/EvalStatusPill/EvalStatusPill.tsx (fixture content unchanged)
Skill reported that the component already exists
Skill suggested using /update-component EvalStatusPill
packages/agents/src/index.ts was not modified beyond the fixture setup
